name: Belka

skills.name: Nutcracker Shell
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Sylvan Vault
skills.description:
Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 130% ATK to it. Increases the damage of this attack based on (3% x the number of Negative Charge) on the field, up to a maximum of 15%. If the target is a boss unit and has Negative Charge, increases damage immediately to 15% instead

If thie attack CRITs, increases Confectance Index by 1 point. After this skill is used, selects an empty tile within a 6 tile range and lands on the designated tile

skills.name: Crackling Core
skills.description:
Selects an enemy target within a 6 tile radius and deals Electric damage equivalent to 130% ATK. For each movement point consumed, increases damage multiplier by 5%

Belka gains 1 layer of Active Engagement. After this skill is used, Belka can use Sylvan Vault or Nutcracker Shell

skills.name: Leaping Arc
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Electric damage equivalent to 160% ATK, and applies Conductivity for 1 turn. For each movement point consumed, increases damage multiplier by 5%. Belka gains Continual Release for 2 turns

skills.name: Forest's Secrets
skills.description:
At the start of the turn, increases Confectance Index by 1 point

Before attacking, applies Negative Charge on the target and the nearest enemy for 1 turn. If the target is killed, gains Concealment

For each Negative Charge applied by allies, increases CRIT rate by 5%, up to a maximum of 30%

fortification.effect: For each movement point consumed, increases damage multiplier by 8% instead. Increases damage by 15% towards enemy targets with Negative Charge

Gains one stack of Active Engagement

New effect is added for Continual Release - If the target of this skill is the same as the target of Continual Release this turn, applies Overflowing Electrons before attacking that lasts for 2 turns

Before attacking, applies Conductivity on the target for 1 turn. When attacking enemy targets with Negative Charge, ignores 10% DEF

When Belka deals single target Electric damage towards enemy targets with Negative Charge, increases the damage multiplier of fixed damage dealt by Negative Charge to 40%. For each Electric damage dealt by allies, Belka gains 1 stack of Stored Charge

At the start of the battle, increases movement speed and attack range by 1 tile

Increases the upper limit of Stored Charge by 4 stacks. For each instance of Electric damage dealt by self, additionally gains 1 stack of Stored Charge

Increases Stability damage dealt by 2 points. Increases CRIT DMG of this attack by 30%

Increases the damage of this attack based on 6% x the number of Negative Charge on the field, up to a maximum of 30%. If the target is a boss unit and has Negative Charge, increases damage immediately to 30% instead

For each movement point consumed, increases damage multiplier by 10% instead. Increases the damage multiplier of Continual Release by 30%

If the target has 2 or more Electric type debuffs, increases CRIT DMG by 30%

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Lively Energy
keys.effect: When Concealment ends, Belka recovers HP equivalent to 30% max HP and 4 Stability

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Offensive of Tears
keys.effect: If Belka has Continual Release, she becomes immune to movement displacement effects

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Atmosphere Booster
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, if there are enemies within a 5 tile radius of self, gains Movement Up I for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Raised Tail
keys.effect: Crackling Core: When using this skill to attack a target with Negative Charge, increases ATK by 10%

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Desired Praise
keys.effect: At the end of the action, if there are boss units with Negative Charge, gains Critical Rate Boost I and Damage Up I for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Deciding Motive
keys.effect: Leaping Arc: Before this skill is used, dispels 2 buffs from the target

keys.name: Common Key - The Will to Fight for Favor
keys.effect: ATK +5% / If movement points are consumed, increases damage dealt by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Squirrel's Resolve
keys.effect:
Sylvan Vault deals Electric damage instead. Increases the CRIT DMG of this attack by 5% per allied unit with Positive Charge, up to a maximum of 25%

When using Crackling Core or Leaping Arc, if Belkas has moved less than 10 times, the movement is treated as 10 tiles
